messages:
marc: Quick announcement: Security is enabling Just-In-Time (JIT) access for all DBA and S3-admin roles across prod clusters. This reduces standing privileges and helps meet audit ask. Read actions below.

zia: When does this go live?

marc: Rollout schedule:
- 2026-03-30 00:00 UTC: JIT enforcement enabled for new role assignments.
- 2026-04-06 00:00 UTC: Backfill flagging run to create rotation tickets for long-lived role bindings.
- 2026-04-13 00:00 UTC: Auto-revoke of sessions still standing without JIT approval.

lina: What counts as JIT-approved?

marc: JIT-approved = a time-bound, audited session created via `rwdnctl access request --role <role> --duration <h>` or through the Console "Request Access" flow which triggers approval and issues a short-lived credential.

lia: Sorry, typo; I meant: how do services that require persistent access work?

marc: Services must use service identities with scoped, non-admin roles or use workload identity (OIDC). Persistent admin-level access is not allowed. If you have a legacy connector (on-prem backup, data-migration), open a ticket with the exception form.

sec-bot: Automated inventory (2026-03-22 09:02 UTC): Found 9 role bindings granting `db_admin` or `s3:full_control` with no JIT usage. Created tickets: SEC-8210..SEC-8218.

zia: Practical steps for teams:
1) Audit current bindings: `rwdnctl rbac list --format csv --fields role,principal,created_at,annotations` and grep for db_admin and s3:full_control.
2) Replace non-service human bindings with JIT requests. Example: `rwdnctl access request --role db_admin --duration 2h --reason "schema-migration"`.
3) For CI or automation, migrate to `rwdn_oidc` and use ephemeral credentials. Update infra modules: `modules/iam/role.tf` -> use `assume_role_with_web_identity`.
4) Attach justification and migration plan to the SEC ticket when you rotate bindings.

infra-bot: Note: Affected terraform modules found in repos: infra/db-maint, infra/data-sync. We'll open RFCs in those repos.

lina: Can we get a short grace period for scheduled migrations? Some migrations are in-flight.

marc: We can approve one-week exception windows if you include the migration schedule in the ticket. Exceptions require compensating controls: IP allowlist, limited CIDR, alerting on use, and an explicit end date.

zia: Any monitoring changes?

marc: Yes: we've added alerts for repeated JIT denials and for service accounts requesting admin-level roles more than twice in 24h. Also, audit logs will be shipped to sec-log-bucket with 365d retention.

sec-bot: Reminder scheduled: 2026-03-29 00:00 UTC.

lina: Acknowledged. I'll start inventory and open tickets for infra/data-sync and db-maint.

marc: Thanks. Office hours 2026-03-25 15:00 UTC in #eng-security for any migration help.

infra-bot: Tip: Run `rwdnctl rbac export --role db_admin > db_admin_bindings.csv` to get a CSV dump for teams.

zia: Got it, will coordinate with owners. :thumbsup:
